lastCompletedStory.title: Prove the pane-not-idle single-send against a real tmux pane

nextStoryContext: Added a ninth real-tmux test to test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts covering the US-002/CAM-373 pane-not-idle timeout path: boots a real tmux pane running a genuinely long-lived foreground command (`bash -c 'echo BUSY; sleep 100'`, never a faked pane-content string) so isOrchPaneIdle stays false for the whole idle-gate poll window (no line ends in `>`/`❯`). Calls sendKeysVerified with an explicit short idleTimeoutMs (100ms) + pollIntervalMs (20ms) override -- never anywhere near the 30s IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS default -- and asserts exactly ONE send-keys call plus exactly one push-undelivered event with { reason: 'pane-not-idle', retriesExhausted: 1 }, matching sendOnceUnverified's contract in src/tmux/dispatch.ts. Reused the file's existing scaffolding unchanged (makeSwapSocketSpawn, paneId(), the private TEST_SOCK, tmuxRaw, waitForCondition, the shared afterEach kill-server, test.skipIf(!tmuxAvailable)); did not touch bootPane (which is specific to the raw-echo fixture's submit/drop modes and not needed here since this path never reaches the geometry-verify loop at all). All 8 pre-existing tests in the file still pass unchanged. No src/ changes were needed -- src/tmux/dispatch.ts's sendOnceUnverified behavior already existed from US-002; this story only adds the missing real-tmux proof for it.
